title: Jewel Toned Dutch Pilaf
description: A flavorful and colorful side dish, perfect for accompanying any meal. The jewel toned ingredients add a pop of color and nutrition.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the dutch carrots and cook until slightly tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the jewel rice and pilaf seasoning. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
